title: Retirement accounts and the sponsor: prohibited transactions
rule: Section 4975 prohibits direct or indirect sale, exchange or lease, lending, or furnishing of goods, services or facilities between a plan, including an IRA, and a disqualified person; transfer or use of plan assets benefiting one; and fiduciary self-dealing or third-party pay. Disqualified persons include fiduciaries, service providers, their spouses, ancestors, lineal descendants and descendants' spouses, entities 50 percent or more owned by them, and those entities' officers, directors, 10 percent owners and partners. Participating disqualified persons owe 15 percent of the amount involved yearly, 100 percent if uncorrected, except an IRA owner or beneficiary, whose account loses IRA status from that year's first day, as if distributed. Exemptions exist.
changeWatch: Amendments to the prohibited transaction list or the disqualified person definition in section 4975, to the IRA disqualification rule in section 408(e)(2), or new class exemptions.
